|strategy=By Fred Swartz 8/21/96

>

This is actually more of a card combination than an extra. Get [[Zutton]], [[Jeroen Webb]], KFC, and any rebel leader together, amd you have a combo that's almost as good as [[Grand Moff Tarkin{{!}}Tarkin]] and [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]]. By lowering the opponents battle destiny by 2 each time, you have a darn good chance of having yours be greater. Your opponent will never be able to take out your characters with attrition.
